name: Social media campaign
description: Phases, the posts in each, and every version of every post. Folded until you need it.
long_description:
Six weeks in three phases: tease, launch and keep it going. Each phase holds its posts, and each post holds the work behind it (the copy, then the visuals) and a task for every channel it goes out on. A post's due date is the day it goes out.

It opens on the Gantt with every phase showing what its posts cover. Collapse all to see only the phases, open one to see its posts, and open a post when you need to know who is making the story. Pick the day the campaign starts when you install it, and every task lands in the right week.
